sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
அமைதியாய் இடர் எல்லாம் எதிர் கொண்ட
சுமை தாங்கியே ரகு குல திலகா
sections.translit:
amaidhiyAy idar ellAm edhir koNda
sumai thAngiyE raghu kula thilakA
sections.en: Sri Rama, you are the star of the solar dynasty. You were a support pillar to the family and faced many obstacles.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
சிற்றன்னையின் சொல் கேட்டு ராஜபோகம் விடுத்து
முற்றும் துறந்த முனிபோல் மரவுரி தரித்து
sections.translit:
sitRannaiyin sol kEttu rAjabhOgam vidutthu
mutRum thuRandhA munipOl maravuri dharitthu
sections.en: You obeyed the words of your stepmother and renounced the luxuries of a royal life, and dressed yourself simply with garments made from plants. Like a saint free of all attachments, you left the palace.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
கானில் அலைந்தாய் இல்லாள் சொன்னாளென
மானில் மறைந்த அரக்கனைத் தொடர்ந்தாய்
மாதினை இழந்து மாவிடர் பட்டு சிரங்களை கொய்து
கோதினை அகற்ற சீரெழில் தன்னை அனலிடை புடமிட்டு
sections.translit:
kAnil alaindhAy illAL sonnALena
mAnil maRaindha arakkanaith thodarndhAy
mAdhinai izhandhu mAvidar pattu sirangaLAi koydhu
kOdhinai agatRa sIrezhil thannai analidai pudamittu
sections.en: You wandered in the jungle. You followed the treacherous demon disguised as a deer because your wife Sita wanted that deceptively beautiful deer. You lost your sweetheart and then went through anguish. You waged a war with demons and decapitated them. When the war was done and you returned to your kingdom, you heard a vicious rumor about the fidelity of your spouse among your citizenry. As a husband you believed her, but as a king you allowed Sita to go through an open fire as a test for proof of her innocence. She emerged unscathed. Thus, you faced all obstacles which came your way.

notes:
The last line of the charanam describes the Agni Pariksha that Sita went through to prove her fidelity to Rama during her time in captivity in Sri Lanka. Sita jumped into a fire and came out unscathed, proving her innocence. Rama put her through this ordeal because of the vicious rumors among some citizens in Ayodhya and their lack of belief in Sita’s fidelity. Even the fire test does not quell such gossip (Uttara khanda Chapters 43- 45).
ஸ்ரீமத் வால்மீகி ராமாயண ஸாரம், உரை ஆசிரியர் அண்ணா, ஶ்ரீராமகிருஷ்ண மடம், மயிலாப்பூர், சென்னை-4, ISBN 81-7120-575-5 பக்கம் 925–931.
Rama succumbs to public opinion and exiles Sita to Valmiki Ashram. As an extreme measure, Sage Valmiki arrives in the court and vouches for Sita’s innocence. Sita follows the sage and states in unmistakable language that her love for Rama is eternal and that she has not entertained any other person, even in captivity and under enormous pressure. She then begs her mom, Bhudevi, to come and take her. A throne with a canopy built by a serpent appears and Sita leaves the earth (Uttara Khanda, Chapters 95 - 97).
ஸ்ரீமத் வால்மீகி ராமாயண ஸாரம், உரை ஆசிரியர் அண்ணா, ஶ்ரீராமகிருஷ்ண மடம், மயிலாப்பூர், சென்னை-4, ISBN 81-7120-575-5 பக்கம் 985-990
